end.name_zh: 陕京四线联络点（张家口）
end.name_en: Shaanxi–Beijing Line IV tie-in point, Zhangjiakou area

P6679.corridor_notes: GEM's OtherLanguageAlternativePipelineNames field labels this cancelled 8.8km row '陕京四线联络线' (Shaan-Jing Line IV connecting line). The only officially documented connector matching this description is a ~1km tie-in built as part of the Changchun–Shijiazhuang Phase 2 trunk, linking the trunk's Zhangjiakou West compressor station (万全区) to Shaan-Jing Line IV — see PipeChina's Phase-2 EIA notice ('张家口与陕京四线联通，新建1km管道'). That figure (~1km) does not match GEM's recorded 8.8km, so this GEM row may be either (a) a stale/superseded entry from an earlier route concept later replaced by the shorter Phase-2 tie-in, or (b) a distinct, still-unbuilt longer connector this research could not independently locate. Treating Zhangjiakou West compressor station as the one confidently-sourced anchor point; the far/tie-in endpoint at 8.8km distance is NOT independently confirmed.
P6679.researcher_notes: Only 1 source found describing a Shaan-Jing IV connector in this corridor (PipeChina Phase-2 EIA notice), and its stated length (~1km) conflicts with GEM's 8.8km — falls short of the 2-independent-source / length-corroboration bar. Recommend review of whether this cancelled row should be retired as superseded by the Phase-2 trunk's built-in tie-in, since no separate 8.8km project could be found in current planning documents.
P6679.blockers: No source independently confirms an 8.8km Shaan-Jing IV connecting line distinct from the ~1km Phase-2 tie-in; could not locate the far/tie-in endpoint.
